overview: This 541-page file traces Japan’s economy from the 1932 depression through the war in China and the outbreak of war in Europe. Embassy, consular, and departmental reports document public borrowing, rural debt, trade, industry, currency controls, and shortages. Conference records and competing assessments examine Japan’s economic capacity and vulnerability to sanctions.
interest: Conflicting official assessments, detailed trade statistics, and Japanese press translations reveal how contemporaries judged Japan’s wartime resilience.
